messages:
nina: Pushed a docs PR to consolidate on-prem install examples and add a tiny preflight helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4490 — please skim.
rao: Thanks. Quick ask: can the preflight be a single-file shell script that ops can curl+run? Keep idempotent and echo clear error codes.
taylor: I'll draft conn-sanity.sh. Minimal checks: default route, MTU >= 1400, DNS for control plane, and TCP connect to example KMS/HSM ports.
nina: Also adding a short USB-HSM section (semi-airgapped) showing socat bridge + udev rule and a container-device note. Make sure we call out PKCS#11 socket permissions.
rao: For socat example please include a systemd transient service example to run the bridge and a caution about exposing the device long-term.
taylor: Draft socat systemd snippet: ```ini
[Unit]
Description=USB HSM bridge
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/socat -d -d /dev/ttyUSB0 UNIX-LISTEN:/var/run/pkcs11/usb-hsm.sock,mode=660,unlink-early
Restart=on-failure
```
docs-bot: Linkcheck: offline/mirror/keys.gpg -> 404. Suggested replacement: https://mirror.redwood.internal/keys/rdw-gpg.asc.
rao: Added a small table calling out nftables vs iptables-legacy and kernel conntrack defaults (nf_conntrack_max). Suggest a sysctl snippet to bump it for high-concurrency sites.
nina: Good. One wording nit: prefer term "sealed deployment" over "sealedsite" for consistency across docs.
taylor: conn-sanity.sh snippet (brief): ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# quick preflight checks
ip route show default >/dev/null || echo "no default route" && exit 2
MTU=$(ip -o link show dev eth0 | awk -F"mtu " '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$MTU" -ge 1400 ] || echo "low mtu: $MTU"
getent hosts control.redwood.internal >/dev/null || echo "control plane DNS fail"
# ports to check (examples): 8500 22600
for p in 8500 22600; do nc -z -w2 control.redwood.internal $p || echo "port $p unreachable"; done
```
ci-bot: Preview: https://ci.redwood.dev/preview/4490 ✅
rao: If nobody objects I'll merge this afternoon. Tagging: docs/private, backport-needed.
nina: Go ahead. Will file a follow-up for adding a short troubleshooting checklist (conntrack, MTU vs encapsulation issues). Closing thread.
